headline: Broad chip selloff sustains elevated Tail
body: Latest verified intraday readings showed the Nasdaq Composite down about 1.4%, the Nasdaq-100 down about 1.5%, and semiconductor weakness near 5%, with all PHLX Semiconductor Index constituents lower in a contemporaneous update. High Treasury yields, elevated oil and unresolved Hormuz risk remain aligned amplifiers, while detailed NQ pullback structure is still incomplete.
